hypotheses.J1_canonical_output_axes_transfer: The best matched mean cosine between FineWeb tensor-canonical output axes and every evaluation-corpus canonicalization is at least 0.80.
hypotheses.J2_joint_rank8_reconstructs_tail_scores: The frozen common rank-8 input basis has median per-axis score correlation at least 0.95 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J3_joint_rank16_near_exact_scores: The frozen common rank-16 input basis has centered vector-score R2 at least 0.98 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J4_joint_rank16_behavioral_fidelity: Replacing native tail-4 scores with common-rank-16 predictions has median final-distribution KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J5_cross_terms_are_required: At rank 16, retaining the full interaction matrices improves centered vector-score R2 by at least 0.10 over diagonal-only forms on every corpus.
hypotheses.J6_joint_rank16_captures_tensor_energy: The common rank-16 input basis captures at least 95% of the covariance-cleaned tail-map Frobenius energy.
